rejectionReason: No direct operational metric is defensible because the workflow's sole repository actions are generating an SVG diagram, creating a draft pull request, and creating a discussion. Under the operational value framework, safe-output creation, output volume, activity counts, and agent execution quality are explicitly excluded as primary operational attainment metrics.

decisions.selected: Generate weekly SVG diagram summary of agentic workflow health and create a draft PR and discussion
decisions.rationale: Adoption-time workflow markdown (.github/workflows/archivx-agentic-workflows-analyzer.md at commit 134fc10e16a282117bfb386199c1d775a0a8f288) defines the mission as creating an SVG diagram using glowmotion, submitting a draft PR, and posting a discussion.

decisions.selected: Weekly scheduled execution on Monday around 09:00 UTC or workflow dispatch trigger
decisions.rationale: The workflow frontmatter defines schedule trigger (weekly on Monday around 09:00) and workflow_dispatch, processing the past 7 days of agentic workflow logs.

decisions.selected: Bind scheduled run ID and 7-day log window to weekly visualization task
alternatives: Bind to specific workflow run failures
decisions.rationale: Each run operates on the previous 7 days of workflow execution logs downloaded via gh-aw logs.

decisions.selected: Reject output artifacts (SVG diagram files, draft PRs, discussions) as valid operational evidence
alternatives: Use pull request creation as repository evidence
Use SVG diagram file creation as evidence
Use discussion post creation as evidence
decisions.rationale: The operational value framework explicitly forbids using safe-output creation, activity counts, or output volume as operational value evidence.

decisions.selected: Not applicable for blocked design outcome
decisions.rationale: Because no direct operational metric is defensible, no maturation window is defined.

decisions.selected: Mark design outcome as blocked due to lack of defensible direct operational metric
decisions.rationale: All candidate metrics substitute safe-output creation, output volume, or execution quality for direct repository outcomes, violating operational value design rules.

decisions.selected: Null baseline for blocked design outcome
decisions.rationale: No pre-adoption baseline can be scored without a valid primary metric.

decisions.selected: No diagnostic metrics defined for blocked design outcome
decisions.rationale: Diagnostics are omitted when the primary operational value design is blocked.

uncertainties.description: Informational and reporting workflows produce safe-outputs (draft PRs, SVG diagrams, discussions) rather than direct operational changes to repository health or code state.
uncertainties.mitigation: Classify as blocked under the operational value framework and evaluate reporting quality via execution-quality or trace graders instead.

uncertainties.description: Any proposed metric based on draft PR creation, SVG rendering success, or discussion posting measures agent activity or safe-output creation rather than repository outcome attainment.
uncertainties.mitigation: Do not define a pseudo-metric for activity; enforce the rule against substituting activity for operational value.

uncertainties.description: Even if draft PRs with diagrams are eventually merged by human maintainers, merging reflects human review preferences rather than an automated operational state change.
uncertainties.mitigation: Avoid using PR merge status as a proxy for automated operational value.
